Touchlinearcade soccer

Controls
  • WASD or ←↑↓→ — run
  • Space — hold to charge a shot; without the ball, challenge for it
  • F — pass; without the ball, switch player
  • Shift — sprint (watch your stamina)
  • Esc pause · M mute

You always control the highlighted player, and control follows the ball. Touchlines rebound — indoor rules, so the ball is never out of play.
